initial_threshold_policy: Tune after the first seven days of server deployment data.

requests.name: [Werft] readyz unavailable
requests.message: API readiness failed. Follow https://jeongjaesoon.github.io/werft/en/run-server/self-hosting/operate/configuration/#api-settings.

requests.name: [Werft] queue oldest age
requests.message: Input queue is not draining. Inspect scheduler health and capacity in docs/operator/execution.md#reconcilerscheduler와-worker-격리.

requests.name: [Werft] terminate acceptance latency
requests.message: Terminate acceptance p95 exceeded 200 ms. Correlate the API and control transaction logs by request_id; see https://jeongjaesoon.github.io/werft/en/run-server/self-hosting/operate/configuration/#api-settings.

requests.name: [Werft] unknown turn outcome
requests.message: A turn outcome is unknown. Follow docs/operator/execution.md#interrupt-뒤-결과를-알-수-없는-turn.

requests.name: [Werft] interrupt effect latency
requests.message: Interrupt effect p95 exceeded 5 s. Correlate control.result and worker.turn.interrupt.stage by control_id; see docs/operator/execution.md#interrupt-뒤-결과를-알-수-없는-turn.

requests.name: [Werft] checkpoint pending
requests.message: Checkpoint state has remained pending. Follow docs/operator/execution.md#checkpoint-복원이-계속-실패하는-세션.

requests.name: [Werft] checkpoint failure
requests.message: Checkpoint capture or finalize failed. Follow docs/operator/execution.md#checkpoint-복원이-계속-실패하는-세션.

requests.name: [Werft] checkpoint capture late
requests.message: Checkpoint capture exceeded its interrupt budget. Follow docs/operator/execution.md#checkpoint-복원이-계속-실패하는-세션.

requests.name: [Werft] checkpoint capture latency
requests.message: Checkpoint capture p95 exceeded 20 s. Inspect durations_ms on worker.checkpoint.published; see docs/operator/execution.md#checkpoint-복원이-계속-실패하는-세션.

requests.name: [Werft] checkpoint bundle near limit
requests.message: A workspace bundle exceeded 80% of the 256 MiB limit. Inspect the published checkpoint before it is refused.

requests.name: [Werft] checkpoint untracked bytes near limit
requests.message: Untracked workspace bytes exceeded 80% of the 256 MiB limit. Inspect the published checkpoint before capture is refused.

requests.name: [Werft] checkpoint manifest near limit
requests.message: A checkpoint manifest exceeded 80% of the 8 MiB limit. Inspect object counts and transcript growth before publish is refused.

requests.name: [Werft] stale execution lease
requests.message: At least one live attempt is past lease expiry. Inspect reconciler health in docs/operator/execution.md#reconcilerscheduler와-worker-격리.

requests.name: [Werft] worker launch churn
requests.message: Worker resources are repeatedly failing to launch. Follow docs/operator/execution.md#시작-단계에서-계속-죽는-세션.

requests.name: [Werft] worker exit churn
requests.message: Worker resources are repeatedly exiting. Follow docs/operator/execution.md#시작-단계에서-계속-죽는-세션.

requests.name: [Werft] scheduler pass failed
requests.message: A scheduler pass failed. Inspect its structured log and status file using docs/operator/execution.md#reconcilerscheduler와-worker-격리.

requests.name: [Werft] provider fallback pricing
requests.message: Provider usage used fallback pricing. Verify the deployed price table before interpreting cost.

requests.name: [Werft] provider hourly cost
requests.message: Provider cost for the last hour exceeded the initial alpha threshold. Check installation and session limits in https://jeongjaesoon.github.io/werft/en/run-server/self-hosting/operate/configuration/#installation-limits.

requests.name: [Werft] Docker disk pressure
requests.message: Docker host disk usage exceeded 80%. Follow docs/operator/test-ops.md#감시-지점.

requests.name: [Werft] host inode pressure
requests.message: Host inode usage exceeded 80%. Follow docs/operator/execution.md#worker-workspace의-상한과-회수.
